notes.title: NEW DEMO available, Soundtrack & more!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello all FLASHOUT fans![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/5c0dcc32c2114159e6b1479782654d88882756ec.gif[/img]

After [b]FLASHOUT 3 got released on Steam[/b], we were mainly focused on making the whole experience more enjoyable, so we gathered the initial feedback and responded with a set of updates, that addressed some minor issues that came up after the release.

We fixed the issue with unresponsive controls on the Mac platform, we fixed a blocker in the last tournament, we updated the localization, did some sound and graphical fixes, but mainly we [b]changed a bit the amounts of points that are required to unlock ships, circuit, weapons and upgrade[/b]s in the game - now it should be much easier to achieve :). We also [b]added EXP points to Time Trial[/b] - a much requested feature. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/d7497eacc9e2ee0940ca6cecd1972e25f07273a9.gif[/img]

These are however not all the small fixes that we introduced here and there - for details check out patch notes.

But we did not spot there. After lot of feedback, [b]we also reworked a bit the tutorial[/b] - now it's focused only on the things you really need to know, so there are less frustrating pop-ups.

Last but not least, [b]we updated the demo version to match the final version of the game[/b]. So if you still didn't buy the full game and you have doubts, the demo is available again, but now it shows you a bit more from the game - [b]you can check out all the main gameplay modes available in FLASHOUT 3[/b], so you can take part not only in a Standard race, but also in Destruction and Elimination modes. notes.title: FLASHOUT 3: F3D: Enhanced Edition, Split Screen & more!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello all FLASHOUT fans![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/d5bc1cecacf056cf0426c81cc909c9dd464bc0c2.gif[/img]

Today we have some really cool news to share with you! As you might already know, 10 years ago we have released the first game in the series - [b]FLASHOUT 3D[/b]. Since it's the[b] 10th anniversary of the first game[/b] and [b]FLASHOUT 3[/b] is coming this year, we wanted to celebrate these two facts with you. Especially that [b]FLASHOUT 3D[/b] was never present on Steam - it was being sold in boxes (on DVD) and the digital version was limited to just a few online stores. The game was also present on the OUYA platform (well... you probably forgot that such console even existed - however [b]FLASHOUT 3D[/b] and [b]FLASHOUT 2[/b] were one of the most popular games on this hardware) and on mobile devices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/bf4af24f9fa8d8ef869cb972372fe93b071ceef8.gif[/img]

Nevertheless, as we wrote above it was never present on Steam - [b]an oversight that needs to be fixed[/b]. And we decided to fix it properly, so [b]we took the classic, 10-years old game and remastered it a bit[/b]. Now [b]FLASHOUT 3D[/b] offers updated graphics, full gamepad support (with vibrations), a new UI, better controls and much more! The great news is that we will offer [b]FLASHOUT 3D: Enhanced Edition 100% FREE OF CHARGE[/b]! That's right, when the Enhanced Edition releases later this month (September 2 to be precise) [b]it will be free[/b]! And of course no microtransactions, no sirs!

So if you don't want to miss this moment and would like to travel to the past and play one of classic AG racers, [b]wishlist FLASHOUT 3D: Enhanced Edition now[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2022780

[h2]Now let's go back to FLASHOUT 3, shall we? :)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/5c0dcc32c2114159e6b1479782654d88882756ec.gif[/img]

First of all we would like to confirm that we are on track with the production and right now we are focused on polishing the Main Menu. Here's a small sneak peek of what we have come up this far, but it's still [b]work in progress[/b], so you will see the final version closer to the release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/a8403313f20dc824d340794ff018da45b331097e.gif[/img]

We have also told you, that we were planning to add a [b]Split Screen mode[/b] allowing you to race against a friend or member of your family on one computer. We know this is a bit of a retro feature, but in our opinion a feature that is missed. So we can confirm that the Split Screen mode is ready and working like a charm! We also thought that it would be cool if you could choose if you want to split the screen [b]horizontally [/b]or [b]vertically[/b]. That's a pretty nice feature if you own an ultrawide monitor, giving you more horizontal space. So here's how it looks like:

[b]Horizontal Split Screen[/b] (best choice for 16:9 monitors):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/a48edf68e81790ec56723985220e24224a4c0d7b.gif[/img]

[b]Vertical Split Screen[/b] (best choice for 21:9 monitors and wider):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/8b6ab7dccab498c1ae6047dc473da89f87de0a52.gif[/img]

But obviously which Split Screen version you prefer to use on your setup is your call ;).

So that's all for today - we hope you are pleased with the news and more info is around the corner, so stay tuned for additional [b]FLASHOUT 3[/b] info in the upcoming weeks!

notes.title: FLASHOUT 3: Cockpit View and quick look at VR!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello all FLASHOUT fans![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/5c0dcc32c2114159e6b1479782654d88882756ec.gif[/img]

Long time no see, but we were really busy during recent weeks. So it's time for a small update on the progress we have made with the development of the game. As you already know, we decided to add VR support and this required us to work on a few very important things. First of all we wanted to make sure that [b]FLASHOUT 3[/b] works on[b] all popular VR headsets[/b] - so not only Oculus or HTC Vive, but also on such devices as headsets made by Pimax. This was quite important, because these devices give you a much better FOV and that's something really important in racers - especially in anti-gravity racers where the circuits can have pretty crazy layouts :).

Another important thing was to [b]optimize the game[/b]. You need to render everything twice, thus the processing power required to achieve constant and acceptable framerates is quite higher, obviously. We managed to achieve really good results in this respect and the good news is that optimizations will also have a positive impact on the standard version of the game. So it's a win-win situation.

Last but not least we knew VR needs to be really immersive. So adding a [b]cockpit view[/b] was a must. But it was a bigger challenge than some of you might expect, because once again - anti-gravity racers are quite different than ordinary racing games. Nevertheless here's what we came up with finally:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/c990912349505cdd55630a0b2451e745b51a3056.gif[/img]

[h2]There are two important things to mention here:[/h2]

1. As you can see, in VR mode the GUI is working a bit like a [b]HUD in a modern car[/b]. So we have moved all the information that was displayed on the screen to the cockpit. This way it's much easier to read all the info and it's, well... more cool :).

2. Because it's an anti-gravity racer, there are not only crazy loops and bends on the circuits, but also jumps and special actions that the player can perform - such as barrel rolls. And why this is a problem? The answer is quite simple - not only you need to have the possibility to look what is above you, but also what is laying below - because when you jump you want to know where to land. This is why [b]in FLASHOUT 3 the cockpit is semi-opened[/b]. It means that you can see the main frame that holds the ship together, as well as your character (full body or hands and legs - depending on your choice), but you don't see the body of the ship. And it still makes sense, because in [b]FLASHOUT 3[/b] racers are using AR headsets during races, just like one of the main characters:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/c935a34b3967e46b1d0e04df3185d97dbd2d84d2.gif[/img]

It is also important to note that the VR version of [b]FLASHOUT 3[/b] will support keyboard and standard game controllers (gamepads, wheels, hotas). Since it's a racing game we have no plans to support dedicated VR controllers (they just don't offer you enough control in racing games).

Obviously since we brought the cockpit view to VR mode, it's [b]also present in the standard version[/b]. We are still perfecting it, but we already have the possibility to change the camera view to cockpit view also in the standard (no-VR) version of the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/4a80f3a6ff11ce3e4d4f6d9220f69ef5e8a5b362.gif[/img]

In the upcoming weeks we will show you [b]a few new circuits[/b] and we also have some good news if you're more of a multiplayer kind of soul - we are currently working on [b]split-screen multiplayer[/b], a feature that is in our opinion missing in most racing games. The split-screen multiplayer will support two modes - vertical and horizontal split-screen. Pretty handy if you're a lucky owner of a widescreen monitor :).

And what about online multiplayer? Will see ;). 

Meanwhile you can still check out the demo version.[b] We are planning to add VR mode to it on Monday,[/b] so stay tuned!

notes.title: FLASHOUT 3: VR & motion simulators support!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello all FLASHOUT fans![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/5c0dcc32c2114159e6b1479782654d88882756ec.gif[/img]

It's time for a new update on the development of the game and today we have some great news to share - especially if you're fan of VR experience. Yes,[b] the game will support VR[/b] and we want to have it ready for the launch of the game. But that's not all. We are also working on the implementation of motion - that means that[b] the game will support DOF simulators (motion platforms)[/b], so you will get the most realistic experience there is! There are no many arcade games supporting such platforms, so we believe this should be something refreshing and extremely fun - as you can see below ːsteamhappyː.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/e861aefaba61697f6ada040326167cc58f85d39e.gif[/img]

Speaking of fun. Next time we will show you another circuit that will be featured in the game - we call it [b]Aquarium [/b](it's a working title, but it might stay) and it will take you underwater. Here are three GIFs to give you a small taste and just imagine how it will look like in virtual reality :). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/a05e705b2a8159885cf2a7ebf2c0c4a7ee21078d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/693e4c3bfe4db0f3c0ec255cbffe310c54e43ac1.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/caf0514f4686d93fffef9955eda6cf9459febcff.gif[/img]

Full video coming soon as well as detailed info on how we plan to celebrate the [b]10th anniversary of the FLASHOUT series[/b]!

So - a traditional reminder - if you're interested in what's coming, make sure to wishlist the game and to check the upcoming announcements :).
